title: makato .claude/config.json
description: Schema for the .claude/config.json configuration file used by makato plugins.

project.description: The name of this makato project/repository.

github_project.description: GitHub Projects v2 board configuration, written by issue-to-project --init.

stores.description: Cross-repo store registrations. Each entry describes a remote repository that this repo can read from or publish to via makato cross-repo workflows.

id.description: Unique identifier for this store within the config. Used as a stable reference key in skill invocations.

repo.description: The GitHub repository in owner/name format (e.g. macatocz/platform).

description.description: Human-readable description of this store's purpose.
